audience: field sales teams that track leads and reps in SalesRabbit

useCases.title: Find leads by owner or status
useCases.text: List leads filtered by status, owner, name or change time. Open one lead for its contact details, notes and custom fields.

useCases.title: Report on lead status changes
useCases.text: List status changes across leads since a time, or read the status history of one lead.

useCases.title: Check reps, roles and org units
useCases.text: List users with their roles and permissions, and the org units such as teams, offices and regions.

useCases.title: Find the area for a location
useCases.text: Find the company areas that contain a latitude and longitude, or only the areas assigned to one user.

useCases.title: Create or update a lead
useCases.text: Create a lead for an owner and status, or overwrite fields of one lead. Confirm the owner, status and values before the write.
